key_highlights: David Jones collapses into administration ahead of Christmas following failed landlord negotiations, highlighting acute discretionary retail distress.
NAB full-year profit drops to $6.1 billion alongside rising overdue mortgage repayments as RBA rate hikes to 18-year highs bite bank margins.
High Court landmark ruling hits Uber with an $81 million payroll tax liability, classifying drivers as wage earners and disrupting Australian gig economy business models.
Global macro tailwinds from Wall Street post-US midterms provide brief relief, but tumbling oil prices and domestic recession warnings weigh on broader ASX sentiment.

sectors.trend: Margin compression and escalating credit impairment as cash rates reach an 18-year peak.
sectors.implications: Elevated mortgage delinquency risk across major banks (NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX); pressure on net interest margins (NIM) and dividend payout ratios.

sectors.trend: Severe structural stress culminating in David Jones entering administration.
sectors.implications: Heightened earnings risks for cyclical retailers; retail footprint consolidation and aggressive discounting ahead of Christmas.

sectors.trend: Retail landlord headwind from anchor tenant collapse and residential property affordability strains.
sectors.implications: Valuation pressure and renegotiation risks for shopping mall landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX, GPT.AX) alongside weakening residential sentiment.

sectors.trend: Regulatory and structural reclassification shock for gig platforms alongside broader sector cost rationalisation.
sectors.implications: Uber payroll tax precedent threatens tech platform unit economics; Canva 1,200 job cuts signal retrenchment across Australian tech valuations.

sectors.trend: Global crude weakness following US midterm political shifts and demand headwinds.
sectors.implications: Near-term margin pressure on pure-play oil and gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX), despite modest relief for consumer transport costs.

sectors.trend: Exploration breakthroughs in titanium, polymetallics, and critical minerals amidst tighter environmental compliance.
sectors.implications: Resource junior catalysts (McLaren, Orbit, Dateline) contrast with WA environmental restrictions and sluggish bulk commodity demand.

key_themes: 18-year high RBA cash rate driving household mortgage arrears and recession alarms from major banks.
Discretionary retail insolvency wave led by department store giant David Jones.
Judicial redefinition of gig economy employment liabilities with substantial tax implications.
Sovereign critical mineral partnerships and domestic exploration momentum balancing weak commodity prices.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LTV domestic mortgage lenders; favour well-capitalised banks with diversified wholesale and business lending books.
Reduce exposure to retail-heavy A-REITs facing anchor tenant vacancies; reallocate toward industrial and logistics assets.
Maintain defensive positioning in consumer staples, defensive healthcare (CSL.AX), and cash equivalents.
Avoid platform-based gig businesses exposed to statutory wage and retrospective payroll tax liabilities.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate high-grade critical minerals and diversified resource majors on weakness
opportunities.rationale: Sovereign US-Australia support for REE/gold assets and local exploration success provide resilient medium-term upside against domestic cyclical declines.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight essential retail and consumer staples over discretionary retailers
opportunities.rationale: Consumers trade down to staple grocers and discount conglomerates amid widespread department store distress and high mortgage repayments.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to retail REITs with department store exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration creates immediate lease default, renegotiation, and co-tenancy vacancy risks across major shopping centres.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad ASX exposure against escalating recession and banking credit risks
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB earnings contraction, rising mortgage arrears, and 18-year high RBA interest rates signal broader market downside for the benchmark index.

market_outlook.short_term: 1–3 month ASX outlook: Bearish to range-bound (^AXJO). Global post-US election relief rallies will be constrained by domestic mortgage stress, retail insolvencies, and bank earnings downgrades.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month medium-term outlook: Cautious recovery. Subdued consumer spending and potential recessionary quarters will eventually force RBA policy pivot, setting up cyclical recovery led by resources.
key_catalysts: RBA board minutes and future cash rate trajectory following 18-year peak hike
David Jones administration proceedings and impact on landlord leasing revenues
Major bank credit loss provision revisions in upcoming trading updates
US midterm political landscape changes affecting global energy and trade policies
watch_list: Australian 90-day bank bill rates and mortgage arrears rate updates
AUD/USD exchange rate behaviour amidst recession commentary
Retail vacancy indices and discretionary spending data ahead of Christmas
Crude oil (Brent/WTI) price trends following US midterm developments
